name: zan-workflows
description: TAPD Bug repair and requirement development with scoped plans, task links, verified implementation and explicit delivery.

interface.shortDescription: TAPD Bug 修复与需求开发，按实际需要准备和交付。
interface.longDescription: Two implementation workflows for TAPD Bug repair and requirement development, plus direct test submission for existing work after developer inspection. Confirm one complete multi-project checklist, then reuse its authority across verified implementation, delivery and scoped automatic conflict handling. Standalone skills retain their own concrete-plan confirmations. Default delivery includes test-branch merge, accepted test-build submission without waiting for completion, and shared Wiki; narrower requests override defaults and go-live requires explicit scope.
defaultPrompt: 面向中文用户时，按 references/execution-checklist.md#限制与确认说明，用完整中文解释限制、上线门禁、确认要求、阻塞原因和清理约束，包括引用规则及脚本返回的英文原因。说明实际触发条件、受影响操作、缺少的证据或授权，以及恢复执行所需条件；只展示本轮适用的限制。解释本次确认来自哪个技能时，链接出处并引用该技能的中文确认条款，不照抄英文句子；用户未明确要求核对英文原文时，不附英文规则引文。机器字段、枚举、代码、命令、路径和链接保持原样，状态码须配中文含义。中文说明不改变规则含义、操作范围或确认复用，也不新增确认节点。

Use $fixing-bug for TAPD Bugs and $developing-requirement for Story/Task development. Use $submitting-for-test for 直接提测 of existing implementation after developer inspection; do not rerun implementation. Load each capability only at its stage.

For Story requirement implementation, choose preparation from the complete selected scope using references/adaptive-workflow.md: independent page/module behavior and acceptance or coordinated cross-repository responsibilities require Task proposals and formal per-unit Plans even for one developer, existing static pages, mature reuse or Mock-first work. Bounded small edits and one mechanical change across pages may use a brief; selected Task inputs never expand to siblings. The first complete implementation checklist includes real/proposed Tasks, verified owners, calibrated final hours and exact proposed module Plan paths/content; missing facts remain a draft. Separate independently deliverable page development and real API integration Tasks in the same module Plan. Mock-only authority excludes future integration from current work/hours; retain future candidates and dependencies without auto-creation. Use distinct page/module subdirectories under the approved project requirement root; an overview only indexes Plans/dependencies. Preview inadequate single-file rule changes through existing Plan gates. Estimate actual responsibility, verified reuse and concrete increments, incorporating applicable user throughput references without treating them as measured/global standards or assuming hours per day; count shared costs once and require independent review. Retain unchanged historical hours. Display only N 小时. Route approved Task creation through breaking-down-requirement to TAPD MCP create_task/create_tasks; checklists and Plans consume the same verified result.

Before initial writes, finish read-only preparation of all selected delivery targets and the Wiki preview, then render references/execution-checklist.md#完整展示模板 in full. Scope review and branch preflight are not execution-confirmation points. Show 确定清单 with multi-project overview, a selected TAPD Task table (序号/标题/工时) before 执行内容, six columns, indexed notes and concrete writes. Prefix Task titles with the current operation 【新建】/【复用】/【调整】 and retain real links. Show only one N 小时 value in each hours cell, without estimate/remaining labels, multiple time values or before/after arrows. CREATE/UPDATE uses the confirmed final Task value; REUSE uses its verified readback. Keep old values and remaining predictions internal. Show only the Task list without totals, subtotals or missing-value counts. Keep unknowns explicit in their rows and list each Task once across projects. Display labels and remaining-work predictions never overwrite Task names or estimates or trigger scheduling. Use stable #F01 task references later; detail #01 and real Task/Plan identities stay separate. Ordinary repair/development defaults to test-branch merge, test build/deploy and shared Wiki, subject to explicit overrides and confirmation. Preview Wiki before confirmation. Approved content becomes 执行清单; material changes re-display the complete 确定清单. Preserve completed effects.

For fixing-bug/developing-requirement, reuse human approval of the complete execution checklist across downstream skills after exact scope/derivation checks. Do not request a second submission/build/Wiki approval for covered operations or technical PLAN states. Standalone skill calls still display and confirm their own concrete plans. Include scoped automatic A-to-C-to-B conflict resolution in the first checklist; validate and review it before continuing, with no unapproved cleanup. Only material scope/operation changes or genuinely missing user decisions need further input. End the main workflow with actual execution results and next-step advice, not routine continue/cleanup questions.

Use the original fixed branch for continued work. Bug implementation includes verified repair ownership and start/completion records. Ordinary full Bug repair first enters 修复中, then reaches 待测试 only after test-delivery gates pass. Show the final TAPD target under 合并与测试环境, distinguish planned targets from actual readbacks, and preserve existing implementation-only and idempotent continuation policies. Requirement implementation covers only selected Tasks and their acceptance.

Complete relevant verification and independent final review before default test delivery. Requirement checklists default to 直接提测：是. Explicit implementation-only requests, 先完成代码，我检查后再提测, 先不要提交/推送 or 暂不直接提测 show 直接提测：否 and stop at REVIEWED without delivery writes. Later direct submission refreshes existing diff/refs and invalidated verification/independent review, shows its exact delivery checklist and obtains matching authorization. 直接提测 does not imply SKIP; only an explicit no-build choice disables Jenkins. Business scope restrictions such as 只开发 B 端相关功能, 仅改前端 or 只做所选 Task retain default test delivery; only a delivery endpoint restriction such as 仅开发验证 or 不提测 disables it. Merge/build means the verified dev/develop target and project test environment, subject to the exact delivery plan. Test submission uses completionMode=TRIGGER_ACCEPTED and proceeds on the exact BUILD_SUBMITTED queue receipt without waiting; report build submitted, never deployment or publication success; go-live requires an explicit request.
Use submitting-for-test and going-live only for the requested delivery stage. Their exact write plans, readbacks, manual-merge handoff and separately confirmed cleanup remain authoritative.
Jenkins 提测结果显示“构建任务已提交”，面向用户的测试构建链接使用回执中已核实的 jobUrl；queueId/queueUrl 仅作内部触发接受证据。修正展示链接时复用原回执，不重新触发构建，也不增加队列、构建或日志查询；buildUrl 仅在真实读回本次构建后补充，不预造链接或声称部署、发包成功。

Separate business decisions in 需求待确认 from 外部数据与依赖 (contract/transport fields/credential configuration/environment facts) and internal implementation evidence. Follow references/external-data-dependencies.md and references/mock-development.md. Preserve one Plan/brief and original Task/branch; dependency completion alone does not reset business approval. Scope readiness to approved current steps/stage, retaining future blockers. Every Mock has stable MOCK-* and MOCK_ONLY identity, actual paths, scenarios, real-call boundary and exit evidence. Mock is local-only by default. Ordinary development/direct submission/default deployment does not authorize Mock testing: display exact inventory, source contents, test target/environment, purpose and operations and obtain real human confirmation before the first selected delivery write. Reuse only matching explicit authority. Run scripts/mock-safety.mjs at delivery boundaries, including standalone helpers and daily builds. Production/default-branch delivery forbids active production-scope Mock and requires verified source exit/build exclusion plus version-bound project scripts that check source before triggering and actual final artifacts before publishing, with failure stopping publication; disabled switches, retired labels or query-contract release-check alone are insufficient. Use scripts/project-mock-gate.mjs and the self-contained assets/project-mock-check template. Verify real release-entry integration from pinned project/Jenkinsfile source and exact build receipts; Jenkins XML access and a fixed Pipeline syntax are not prerequisites. Missing actual project checks still block production. New PagePlan v4 and ReviewSession v3 preserve externalDependencies and mockModules; legacy missing review stays unverified.

Jenkins build parameters are maintained separately in project-knowledge/data/workspace/jenkins-build-contracts.json, with explicit sources/jenkins-build-policies.json profiles. Follow references/frozen-jenkins-parameters.md. Never query Jenkins parameter definitions, extract them from XML, or auto-refresh in deployment PLAN/EXECUTE. Use the frozen resolver to validate exact project/Job/profile, materialize all defaults, bind actual values and reject fixed environment/release-selector overrides. Missing/unavailable/ambiguous records block until the independent maintenance sync succeeds. Daily and full builds use run-jenkins-release.mjs with current local Job/profile/value hashes; source/Job/queue and production Mock checks remain separate.

For top-level workflows follow references/execution-feedback.md: create one local diagnostic runId, reuse it across stages and pass ZAN_WORKFLOWS_RUN_ID to workflow-session. Record observed stages, confirmation subjects, corrections and final outcomes; distinguish executor events from agent summaries and preserve coverage gaps/UNKNOWN. Diagnostics never store raw plans/results or authorize/replay writes, and recording failures do not stop work. Use report-execution only for a user-requested report/export. Upload only on explicit feedback submission to the hardcoded GitLab project http://git.jubaozan.cn/chenfangjie/skills (ID 374), freshly verified before each submission; do not ask for another upload confirmation when that exact request already authorizes it. Never auto-upload every run. Do not ask for destination setup or expose destination configuration, and never infer a different destination from the current business repository.
